title: Data and code for Service-Preserving Generative Moving Target Defense for Web Applications
description: Data-only v2-series release based on 60 accepted MiniShop/Flaskr generation slots, bounded four-candidate OWASP Juice Shop edge generation, and Flaskr fixed-target response timing. Excludes the S0/S1/S2 three-arm attack cohorts and manuscript files. The prior v2.0.0 DOI remains historical.
